characters.name: Hettie Rann
characters.goal: Prevent the water board from seizing her family farm.

characters.name: Arthur Vane
characters.goal: Enforce the valley evacuation before reservoir impoundment begins.

characters.name: Clara Pike
characters.goal: Salvage the family livestock and household goods before the water rises.

characters.name: Orson Dale
characters.goal: Complete sluice valve installation to collect his project completion bonus.

locations.name: Sullivant Dam Crest and Control House
Lower Powerhouse and Scour Tunnel Gallery

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establishes Arthur's expropriation of the valley and Hettie's defiance as her family is evicted.
required_beats: Arthur arrives at the farmstead with a clearance squad to present the ministerial expropriation order before the diversion gates drop.
Clara packs the family wagon while Hettie refuses to acknowledge the legitimacy of the order.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Shows the irreversible sealing of the river canyon and the drowning of the valley.
required_beats: Arthur operates the hoists at the dam crest while sealing the canyon bulkheads and confirming the sediment scour valve counterweights lock irrevocably into position.
From the perimeter, Hettie watches the water swell toward her family barn.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Solidifies Hettie's lifelong obsession and vow to reverse the flooding of her family home.

char_hettie.goal: Prevent the water board from seizing her family farm.
Master dam engineering to force the reservoir to uncover her drowned farm.

required_beats: Clara urges Hettie to accept the resettlement stipend, but Hettie burns the voucher as the reservoir covers her chimney.
Hettie swears aloud not to lay down her tools until her hearthstones stand in open air.
Hettie pockets a stone from the foundation and boards the transit truck.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Launches Hettie's covert infiltration of the dam's vital operational systems two decades later.
required_beats: Twenty years later, Hettie conducts a structural walkdown of the lower penstocks disguised as an efficiency inspection.
Hettie notes that the downstream intake canal depends on a minimum reservoir pool elevation of two hundred meters.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To establish Hettie securing illicit access to the dam's drainage infrastructure through corruption.
required_beats: Orson Dale offers duplicate release spindle pins for the sediment scour gates in exchange for Hettie approving his padded turbine invoices.
Hettie signs the fraudulent work orders and takes possession of the emergency bypass pin.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To challenge Hettie's perception of Arthur by revealing his spartan life and genuine dedication to downstream safety.
required_beats: At dusk, Hettie observes Arthur Vane living in an unheated trailer on the crest while laboring into the evening to repair manual spillway locks for downstream farms.
Hettie watches Arthur mend his frayed coat and decline corporate bonuses, confounding her expectations of a predatory tyrant.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To uncover the ministerial coercion that forced Arthur's fateful decision twenty years earlier.

char_hettie.status: burdened by the discovery of Vane's coerced signature

required_beats: Hettie bypasses the records room lock in the dam crest archives while searching for original bedrock drainage schematics.
In the legacy maintenance dockets, Hettie discovers an unredacted ministry telex ordering immediate unannounced demolition diversions if Arthur refused to sign the clearance order.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To bring Hettie and Arthur into intimate technical collaboration while exposing his vulnerability and terror of catastrophe.
required_beats: Arthur summons Hettie to the lower powerhouse to inspect turbine vibration data and troubleshoot cavitation damage, praising her technical precision.
While collaborating, Hettie notes Arthur's severe tremor and his palpable dread of an uncontrolled downstream dam failure.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To test Hettie's resolve by confronting her with the humanitarian cost of emptying the reservoir.
required_beats: Clara confronts Hettie in the crest control room after discovering stolen hydraulic blueprints in Hettie's lodgings.
Clara begs Hettie not to compromise the reservoir, warning that five thousand downstream residents depend on the pool staying above the canal sill.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To execute Hettie's long-planned sabotage and force Arthur into complicity and reckoning.
required_beats: During a midnight flood alert in the scour gallery, Hettie corners Arthur, reveals her identity as the girl from Low Meadow, and produces the twenty-year-old coercion telex.
Hettie drives the bypass pin into the sediment scour trip-lever, releasing the counterweights to drain the basin.
Arthur refrains from fighting back and braces the manual damper wheel beside her to absorb shock waves and protect the valley culverts.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To reveal the emotional futility of Hettie's revenge amid the exposed ruins of her past.

char_hettie.goal: Master dam engineering to force the reservoir to uncover her drowned farm.
char_hettie.status: burdened by the discovery of Vane's coerced signature
unburdened of vendetta but hollowed by desolation

required_beats: Hettie crosses the toxic gray silt bed of the drained reservoir to the dry chimney and hearthstones of the Rann farmhouse.
Arthur joins her at the ruin and vows to claim sole responsibility before the state inquiry to shield her from imprisonment.
Standing over the mud with her wrench and calipers, Hettie realizes that settling the debt has restored nothing of her lost life.

voice_card.narrative_distance: close third, pressed against the protagonist
voice_card.register: grave, ornate, foreboding; dwells where a plainer voice would move on
voice_card.sentence_rhythm: long accreting sentences broken by a short one that lands like a door
voice_card.dialogue_density: low; speech arrives rarely and carries weight when it does
voice_card.reader_familiarity: The first time a deep term appears (domain-specific jargon), let dialogue or narration make its meaning clear within a clause. Never lecture.

metadata.title: The Silt and the Hearth
metadata.source: segmented from a Fabula-only package by gemini-3.8-flash

facts.statement: The provincial water ministry issued an irrevocable expropriation order for the entire river basin to construct the hydro dam.
Arthur Vane signed the valley flooding order under ministry threats of an unannounced high-explosive river diversion.
The Rann family held and cultivated the Low Meadow farmstead continuously across four generations.
The deep sediment scour valve opens irrevocably when its mechanical counterweight trip-pin is disengaged under full reservoir pressure.
The downstream municipal water canal requires a reservoir pool elevation of at least two hundred meters to maintain gravity flow.

premise.logline: A woman whose farm was flooded to build a reservoir takes a job on the dam, to learn how it could be made to fail.

modules.theme: whether revenge on a thing can ever reach the people behind it
modules.setting_time: twenty years after the valley was flooded
modules.setting_place: a hydroelectric dam above a drowned village
modules.protagonist: a maintenance engineer who grew up in the drowned valley
modules.protagonist_want: to make the reservoir give back what it took
modules.antagonism: the dam’s manager, who signed the flooding order young
modules.complication: the town below the dam now depends on it
modules.ending_shape: the vow is kept to the letter and broken in spirit

plot_shape.name: Reckoning
plot_shape.central_question: Does the debt get collected, and does collecting it help?

phases.name: The injury
phases.purpose: The original wrong, shown rather than reported.

phases.name: The vow
phases.purpose: A commitment made in a state the maker will not always be in.

phases.name: Preparation
phases.purpose: Means acquired, allies made and used, a self narrowed to a purpose.

phases.name: Contact
phases.purpose: The wrongdoer, close enough to be seen as a person.

phases.name: Aftermath
phases.purpose: What is left of the avenger once the purpose is gone.

cast_roles.purpose: Holds the debt and is deformed by holding it.
Committed the wrong, and has a life that does not look like a villain's.
Helps the claimant for reasons of their own.
Argues for the cost, and is not simply right.

obligatory_moves: The vow is made with a specific, quotable condition attached.
The debtor is shown doing something that is not villainous before contact.
The aftermath addresses the vow's exact wording.

events.summary: Arthur Vane arrives at the Rann farmstead with a clearance squad, forcing Hettie and Clara to vacate their land before the diversion gates drop.
events.dramatic_function: Introduce the original injury by dramatizing the eviction of the Rann family from their ancestral valley.
beats: Arthur presents the ministerial expropriation order to Hettie in her farmhouse yard.
Clara loads the family wagon while Hettie refuses to acknowledge the legitimacy of the order.

events.summary: Arthur lowers the primary river diversion gates at the dam crest while Hettie watches the water begin backing up across the pastures.
events.dramatic_function: Show the physical execution of the wrong and plant the permanent mechanical locking rule of the deep scour gate.
beats: Arthur engages the diversion shutoff hoists, sealing the river canyon with concrete bulkheads.
Arthur verifies that the deep sediment scour valve counterweights lock irrevocably into position once water head exceeds thirty meters.
Hettie watches from the security perimeter as the muddy river swells toward her family barn.

events.summary: In the muddy relocation camp on the reservoir rim, Hettie watches the reservoir rise to submerge the rafters of her home.
events.dramatic_function: Depict the emotional weight of displacement and show the diverging paths between the claimant and the restraint.
beats: Clara urges Hettie to accept the board resettlement stipend and move downstream to the orchard settlement.
Hettie burns her relocation voucher and watches the water cover the chimney of the Rann farmhouse.

events.summary: Standing at the reservoir high-water mark, Hettie speaks a solemn oath to master the dam's machinery and uncover her drowned home.
events.dramatic_function: Establish the claimant's vow with an exact, quotable condition before she departs to acquire technical means.
beats: Hettie speaks an oath aloud that she will not lay down her tools until the reservoir floor is dry to the bedrock and her hearthstones stand in open air.
Hettie pockets a stone from the drowned foundation and boards the transit truck out of the valley.

state_changes.value: Master dam engineering to force the reservoir to uncover her drowned farm.

events.summary: Twenty years later, Hettie begins work as chief turbine mechanic at Sullivant Dam, inspecting the lower galleries to map the bypass infrastructure.
events.dramatic_function: Begin the preparation phase twenty years later and plant the minimum operational elevation threshold for downstream town water.
beats: Hettie conducts a structural walkdown of the lower penstocks under cover of an efficiency inspection.
Hettie observes that the downstream municipal water intake canal relies on a minimum reservoir pool elevation of two hundred meters.

events.summary: Hettie barters falsified maintenance signoffs with Orson Dale in exchange for off-log bypass keys to the sediment scour tunnels.
events.dramatic_function: Demonstrate the claimant corrupting her professional integrity to acquire sabotage tools from an opportunistic enabler.
beats: Orson offers Hettie duplicate release spindle pins for the sediment scour gates in exchange for approving his padded turbine invoices.
Hettie signs the fraudulent work orders and takes possession of the emergency bypass pin.

events.summary: Hettie surveils Arthur Vane at dusk, discovering that he lives in an unheated trailer on the crest while maintaining downstream flood barriers.
events.dramatic_function: Show the debtor performing unvillainous, selfless maintenance before direct contact occurs.
beats: Hettie watches Arthur personally labor into the evening repairing manual spillway locks to ensure steady irrigation flows to downstream farms.
Hettie observes Arthur patch his frayed coat and decline corporate bonuses, confounding her expectations of a predatory tyrant.

events.summary: While searching legacy maintenance dockets in the dam crest archives, Hettie uncovers the secret ministerial ultimatum Arthur faced twenty years ago.
events.dramatic_function: Reveal the hidden backstory that Arthur acted under coercive threat rather than malice.
beats: Hettie bypasses the records room lock to search for original bedrock drainage schematics.
Hettie discovers the unredacted ministry telex ordering immediate unannounced demolition diversions if Arthur refused to sign the clearance order.

state_changes.value: burdened by the discovery of Vane's coerced signature

events.summary: Arthur summons Hettie to the lower powerhouse to troubleshoot cavitation damage, bringing them into direct professional collaboration.
events.dramatic_function: Establish contact between claimant and debtor, forcing Hettie to observe Arthur's genuine dedication and declining health.
beats: Arthur inspects turbine vibration data alongside Hettie, praising her technical precision without knowing her true identity.
Hettie observes Arthur's severe tremor and his palpable dread of an uncontrolled downstream dam failure.

events.summary: Clara arrives at the crest control room representing the downstream water district and begs Hettie not to compromise the town reservoir.
events.dramatic_function: Collect the plant regarding the canal threshold and dramatize the restraint pleading for the innocent town.
beats: Clara confronts Hettie after finding stolen hydraulic blueprints in Hettie's lodgings.
Clara reminds Hettie that five thousand residents in the downstream town rely entirely on the reservoir pool remaining above the canal sill.

events.summary: During a midnight flood alert, Hettie corners Arthur in the scour gallery, confronts him with the past, and trips the bottom drain counterweights.
events.dramatic_function: Execute the confrontation and the physical sabotage while paying off the counterweight lock and the hidden duress facts.
beats: Hettie presents the twenty-year-old coercion telex and declares her identity as the girl from Low Meadow.
Hettie drives the bypass pin into the sediment scour trip-lever, dropping the irrevocable counterweights to purge the reservoir basin.
Arthur does not fight back, choosing instead to brace the manual damper wheel beside her to prevent shock waves from bursting the valley culverts.

events.summary: As the emptied reservoir reveals the barren, silt-choked valley floor, Hettie stands before her dry, ruined childhood hearth in hollow silence.
events.dramatic_function: Conclude the Reckoning by showing the vow fulfilled to the letter and shattered in spirit.
beats: Hettie walks across the barren, toxic gray silt bed where the Rann farmhouse chimney and hearthstones stand dry in open air.
Arthur arrives beside the ruin, accepting full official responsibility before the arriving state inquiry to spare Hettie from imprisonment.
Hettie holds her wrench and calipers over the dead mud, realizing the fulfilled debt has reclaimed nothing of her lost life.

state_changes.value: unburdened of vendetta but hollowed by desolation

hidden_account.summary: The provincial water ministry issued an irrevocable decree condemning the Low Meadow valley to build a regional hydroelectric reservoir.
Arthur Vane signed the eviction and impoundment order because the ministry threatened to blast the river diversion with high explosives without civilian evacuation if he delayed.

facts.statement: The provincial water ministry issued an irrevocable expropriation order for the entire river basin to construct the hydro dam.
Arthur Vane signed the valley flooding order under ministry threats of an unannounced high-explosive river diversion.
The Rann family held and cultivated the Low Meadow farmstead continuously across four generations.
The deep sediment scour valve opens irrevocably when its mechanical counterweight trip-pin is disengaged under full reservoir pressure.
The downstream municipal water canal requires a reservoir pool elevation of at least two hundred meters to maintain gravity flow.
